as_of_version.time_vectors: same explicit symbolic decision cuts as v1; no live provider observation

admitted_class_bound.predicate_meaning: Each Boolean predicate is already source-qualified for the exact root/boundary/as_of. Lower historical/reason facts must not be incorrectly asserted as current active predicates. The selector never manufactures facts or decides semantic admissibility.
admitted_class_bound.signatures: 127 nonempty predicate signatures × proven PERMITTED/PROHIBITED privacy = 254 conditional rows. Applicable source-consistent admitted signatures exhaust this selector class; an upstream inconsistent signature must be explicitly rejected, not fabricated as a valid aggregate.
outside_class: no true semantic predicate for an admitted authorized root
unproven/UNKNOWN privacy (existing A3 blocks unauthorized admission; QD-UNKNOWN-PRIVACY-NEGATIVE)
admitted_class_bound.truth_vs_projection: Primary is one boundary projection. The complete typed internal reason set may include additional material reasons not represented by a winning predicate; every such reason/evidence remains conserved.
admitted_class_bound.no_empirical_exhaustiveness: No claim of exhaustive distributed executions, actual callers or arbitrary canonical-state combinations.
